get_config_sklearn: get the current scikit-learn global configuration including assume_finite, working_memory, and display settings
set_config_sklearn_display: set the scikit-learn global display setting to text or diagram for estimator output formatting
set_config_skip_validation: set scikit-learn to skip parameter validation to save time at the risk of crashes
config_context_assume_finite: temporarily enable assume_finite config context to skip finiteness validation in sklearn
set_config_transform_output_pandas: set scikit-learn transform output format to pandas DataFrame for transformer results
